units.source_text: 就这样，金阁处处皆是，而在现实里却看不见。

en.t: In this way, the Golden Pavilion was everywhere, yet in reality it could not be seen.

units.source_text: 在这一点上，它酷似这块土地上的海。

en.t: In this respect, it closely resembled the sea of this land.

units.source_text: 舞鹤湾位于志乐村西边四公里多地，海被山峦遮挡，看不见了。

en.t: Maizuru Bay lay a little more than four kilometers west of Shiraku Village, and the sea, hidden by the mountains, could no longer be seen.

units.source_text: 但这块土地上总是飘荡着一种预感到海似的东西。

en.t: But over this land there was always something drifting in the air that seemed to foretell the sea.

units.source_text: 偶尔，风丝也送来了海的气息。

en.t: Now and then, even a thread of wind carried the scent of the sea.

units.source_text: 海上一起风暴，海鸥群就纷纷逃命，飞落在这一带的田野上。

en.t: Whenever a storm rose over the sea, flocks of gulls fled one after another and came down into the fields around here.
